summary: Minimal, correct fix adding AlterField-on-AlterField reduction to AlterField.reduce, matching the issue's suggested approach and Django's reduce-pattern conventions. Returns the later operation when the field operation targets the same model/field, which correctly collapses chained AlterFields.

issues.description: The new `elif` line exceeds Django's typical formatting; black would wrap the `isinstance(...) and self.is_same_field_operation(operation)` condition across lines as the surrounding code does. Cosmetic only, not merge-blocking.
